objective: Qualify a new tokenizer-span alignment rule against already-sealed S01-2 tokenizer offsets without loading a tokenizer or model.

alignment_rule.name: MINIMAL_CONTIGUOUS_TOKEN_COVER_V01
alignment_rule.selection: Select every nonspecial tokenizer position i whose valid nonempty source offset [s_i,e_i) intersects the declared semantic character span S=[a,b): s_i < b and e_i > a.
alignment_rule.cover: The selected token positions must be a nonempty contiguous integer interval. The cover character interval is [minimum selected token start, maximum selected token end).
alignment_rule.semantic_coverage: Clip each selected token offset to S. Every semantic character in S must be covered exactly once, with no gaps and no overlaps.
alignment_rule.special_and_offset_integrity: Special positions may not overlap source characters or be selected. Nonspecial positions must have valid nonempty offsets. Any malformed offset, special-token overlap, or tokenizer anomaly affecting a required span fails that span.
alignment_rule.quartet_eligibility: Every context, entity, and relation occurrence in all four A/C/E/P events must pass. A quartet is eligible only when all four events pass all required spans.

fixed_inputs.P_interpretation: The sealed generator labels its paraphrase-only surface realization as OBSERVATION_TEMPLATE.

tokenizer.token_ids_sha256: SHA-256 of consecutive little-endian unsigned 32-bit token IDs, without header or separators

support_gates.on_shortage: FAIL_CLOSED; do not merge cells or lower a threshold

representation_views.assignment: All model-visible positions [0, sequence_length), including special-token positions.
Sorted deduplicated union of valid token positions across every context occurrence.
Sorted deduplicated union of valid token positions across every entity occurrence.
Sorted deduplicated union of valid token positions across every relation occurrence.
Ordered references to V3, V4, V5 positions; no projection, normalization, or cross-span deduplication.

permitted_operations: Verify the sealed parent trees and read their allowlisted corpus, tokenizer offsets, boundary audit, reports, dispositions, and contracts.
Apply the frozen minimal-cover rule to every declared context, entity, and relation span.
Materialize token-index assignments and reconcile them with the sealed S01-2B audit.
Recompute quartet eligibility and all declared support cells.
Write and seal the S01-2C alignment manifest, report, and disposition.
forbidden_operations: Load or instantiate LFM weights, extract hidden states, or create features.
Alter corpus strings, spans, tokenizer outputs, or any S01-2A/S01-2B artifact.
Expand the spill allowlist or change the seven frozen representation views.
Calculate representation geometry, fit probes, train any mechanism, or execute S01-3.

terminal_state.S01_2C_MINIMAL_COVER_ALIGNMENT: PASS only if every required span and every support gate passes
